role: Caduceus carapace: the route, command, and sclerite rosters resolved at build time for one profile

profile.description: Carapace profile name; matches the resolved file stem.

routes.description: Sorted, distinct route namespaces mounted for this profile.

commands.description: Sorted, distinct command names admitted for this profile.

sclerites.description: Sorted, distinct sclerite identifiers lit for this profile.

canonical_bytes: build.rs emits schema/carapace/resolved/<profile>.json as UTF-8 JSON with two-space indentation and one trailing LF.
